name: resource-kit
title: Resource Kit
description: List, detail, and form screens generated from resource definitions: a view with search, sort, pagination, and empty and error states; a table that formats cells by field, shows option badges and relation labels, and folds columns in narrow panes; a create and edit sheet with validation, async relation pickers, and many-to-many links; a record view with has-many lists; and delete confirmation. Backend-neutral: data goes through an injected source, routing through an injected router.
docs: Import: `import { ResourceKitProvider, ResourcePage, RecordDetail, defineResource } from '@/components/ui/resource-kit'`. Describe each table with `defineResource({ name, label, singular, primaryKey, titleField, columns, formFields, fields, source })`, where `source` implements `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `remove`, and optionally `link` and `linked` for many-to-many fields. Wrap the app once in `<ResourceKitProvider router={{ Link, navigate, listHref, detailHref }} resources={[...]} icons={{ users: Users }}>` (it reuses an enclosing QueryClient or makes its own), then render `<ResourcePage resource="contacts" />` on the list route and `<RecordDetail resource="contacts" id={id} />` on the detail route. Writes invalidate the resource and every related one. `DataTable`, `EntityFormSheet`, `RelationPicker`, `DeleteDialog`, `ResourceNav`, and `createMemorySource` are exported for custom screens and prototypes.
